title: Skipped Cycles and the Yearly Skip Allowance — Auto Refill & Medication Sync
content:
Each Auto Refill & Medication Sync enrollment is credited the program's yearly skip allowance — the number of cycles that may be skipped per program year — at enrollment and again at each program-year anniversary. Unused skips lapse at the anniversary and are not carried over. The skips remaining on the enrollment rise by the allowance when it is credited and fall by one for each cycle skipped. A program year begins on the enrollment date, and each anniversary of it begins the next.

## The skip rule

A skip is the patient's own request. A cycle is skipped only when all three of the following hold:

1. the skips remaining on the enrollment are at least 1;
2. the number of cycles skipped in a row is below the program's limit on skips in a row — counted over the enrollment's cycles from the most recent backwards, stopping at the first cycle that was not skipped;
3. the skip is asked for no later than the program's skip cut-off, in hours, before the cycle is processed.

The skips remaining are read from the enrollment's own record, not from the patient's account of them.

A skipped cycle moves the next cycle to the following cycle date and consumes one skip. Once no skip remains, the patient may pause or unenroll instead.

## Input, judgement, output

| Skips remaining | Skipped in a row, against the limit | Asked no later than the cut-off | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 or more | below | yes | The three conditions hold |
| 0 | any | any | Not skipped |
| any | at or above | any | Not skipped |
| any | any | no (later than the cut-off) | Not skipped |

## Worked cases (hypothetical inputs)

**Cut-off.** With a cut-off of 48 hours, a skip asked for exactly 48 hours before the cycle is processed is no later than the cut-off and meets condition 3; one asked for 47 hours before processing does not.

**Skips in a row.** With a limit of 2 in a row:

| The enrollment's cycles, most recent first | Skipped in a row | Condition 2 |
|---|---|---|
| skipped, skipped, filled | 2 | Not met (2 is not below 2) |
| skipped, filled | 1 | Met |
| skipped, held, skipped | 1 (the held cycle is not skipped, so the count stops there) | Met |

**Lapse at the anniversary.** An enrollment whose program allows 3 skips a year still has 1 skip remaining when its program year ends. That skip lapses at the anniversary; the new program year opens with the allowance of 3, not 4.

**Effect of a skip.** When a cycle is skipped, the next cycle moves to the following cycle date and the skips remaining fall by one.
